description:
The European night-train network as open data — stations, services and network attributes from the **Open Night Train Database (ONTD)**, curated since 2023 by [Back-on-Track Europe AISBL](https://back-on-track.eu/), the European umbrella for night-train advocacy.

This catalog is the data-truth view of the network (snapshot **2026-08**); the designed cartographic view is the [Back-on-Track night train map](https://back-on-track.eu/night-train-map/). Three collections: schematic service lines, station points, and the relational attribute tables. Licenses are per collection — geometry under ODbL (station coordinates derive from [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright)), attribute tables under CC-BY-4.0. Start with the [agent guide](AGENTS.md).
title: Back-on-Track Open Night Train Database
